name: PyAgentic
tagline: A declarative, type-safe Python framework for building LLM agents
description:
## What it is
PyAgentic lets you build sophisticated LLM agents using clean, class-based Python. Define an agent as a class, decorate methods as tools, and get persistent state, agent linking, and inheritance — with full type safety throughout.

## Highlights
- **Declarative design** — agents are classes; tools are decorated methods.
- **Provider-agnostic** — target OpenAI, Anthropic, or local Ollama models with a `provider::model` string.
- **Serve any agent** — the optional API layer exposes agents over HTTP with an **auto-generated OpenAPI spec** (and MCP support), so schemas stay in sync with zero manual maintenance.
- **Persistent state** — `State` fields survive across conversations.
- **Agent linking & inheritance** — compose multi-agent workflows and build agent hierarchies.
- **Structured responses** — type-safe Pydantic outputs with full tool-execution detail.
- **Async-first** — built for scalable applications with async/await throughout.

## Install
```bash
pip install pyagentic-core
```

## Stack
Python 3.13+, Pydantic, FastAPI (for the API layer), and MkDocs for the docs site. MIT licensed.

name: Ada
tagline: GPT-powered science explainer that answers with cited sources
description:
## What it does
Ada answers any science question with a well-structured, readable article — generated in minutes, and backed by real references you can explore in the sidebar.

## How it works
A FastAPI backend orchestrates GPT to draft explanations, pull supporting sources, and structure the response; a React frontend renders the article alongside its citations.

## Stack
Python, FastAPI, React, and the OpenAI API.

name: CitiMesh
tagline: SMS service that connects citizens to community resources
description:
## What it does
CitiMesh is an SMS-based service that lets citizens text a number to find resources in their community — food, shelter, healthcare, and local non-profit services — without needing a smartphone or data plan.

## Why
The people who most need community resources are often the least likely to have reliable internet. SMS meets them where they are.

## How it works
A FastAPI backend routes inbound texts through an LLM that maps questions to a curated database of local organizations, and logs anonymized analytics for the government and non-profit partners who run each deployment.

## Stack
Python, FastAPI, Twilio, Azure, and Terraform for infrastructure.
